name: jaeger_high_storage_error_rate
title: Jaeger high storage error rate
description: Jaeger is experiencing a high percentage storage errors.

source.upstream_query: 100 * sum(rate(jaeger_storage_requests_total{result="err"}[1m])) by (instance, job, namespace, operation) / sum(rate(jaeger_storage_requests_total[1m])) by (instance, job, namespace, operation) > 1 and sum(rate(jaeger_storage_requests_total[1m])) by (instance, job, namespace, operation) > 0
source.upstream_description: Jaeger on {{ $labels.instance }} is experiencing {{ $value | humanize }}% storage errors on {{ $labels.operation }}.
source.query_normalized: The upstream threshold could not be lifted out of the expression (its outermost operator is and/or/unless, or it compares against another series), so the expression is normalised to 1 per matching series and the alert fires on any match. The observed value in the notification is therefore always 1.

query_condition.promql: (100 * sum(rate(jaeger_storage_requests_total{result="err"}[1m])) by (instance, job, namespace, operation) / sum(rate(jaeger_storage_requests_total[1m])) by (instance, job, namespace, operation) > 1 and sum(rate(jaeger_storage_requests_total[1m])) by (instance, job, namespace, operation) > 0) * 0 + 1
